# brainworkup

> Established by Dr. Joey Trampush, Brainworkup Neuropsychology, LLC offers specialized neuropsychological evaluations for children to young adults, focusing on ADHD, dyslexia, learning disorders, forensic examinations, and psychiatric assessments.
